rootCause.duplicates: Newsletter dedupe previously ran inside individual lists and used URL+display+brief, so the same source URL could reappear in Top News, Quick Links, What To Watch, or section-derived lists under different labels.
rootCause.mojibake: Content cleanup handled several known broken encodings but did not normalize all extended/decoded characters before rendered HTML/text was saved.

code: uniqueNewsletterItems now dedupes by URL independently of display label.
dedupeNewsletterIssueLists dedupes across Top News, Quick Links, What To Watch, and sourceDirections before render.
cleanEncodingArtifacts normalizes and strips residual extended mojibake characters for public text.
data: Existing Creator Desk and Newsletter JSON was normalized to ASCII-safe public text.
Newsletter duplicate references were removed across public lists.
Rendered html/text was rebuilt from cleaned records.
